concepts.name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands: Strategic and Administrative Significance
key_dimensions: Location at the junction of Bay of Bengal and Andaman Sea — proximity to Malacca Strait chokepoint
Union Territory status with Lt. Governor; tribal reserve areas under Protection of Aboriginal Tribes Regulation
INS Baaz (Car Nicobar) and INS Jarawa — naval air stations and their role in India's maritime domain awareness
Indira Point (southernmost tip of India) vs. Pygmalion Point — UPSC trap on correct terminology and location

concepts.name: Lakshadweep Islands: Geopolitical and Ecological Dimensions
key_dimensions: Only coral atoll Union Territory of India; distinction between atolls, barrier reefs, and fringing reefs
Proximity to key sea lanes — Arabian Sea SLOCs connecting Gulf of Aden to Indian west coast
INS Jatayu (Minicoy Island) — India's second naval base in Lakshadweep and its strategic role against Chinese presence in Indian Ocean
EEZ implications: Lakshadweep grants India a disproportionately large Exclusive Economic Zone relative to land area

concepts.name: Strait of Malacca and Surrounding Island Chokepoints
key_dimensions: Bordered by Malaysia, Indonesia (Sumatra), and Singapore — world's busiest shipping lane
Strategic significance for India: ~80% of China's oil imports pass through it (String of Pearls context)
Riau Islands and Batam Island (Indonesia) as alternative port hubs near the strait
UPSC trap: Strait of Malacca vs. Lombok Strait vs. Sunda Strait — which connects Indian Ocean to Pacific and which countries border each

concepts.name: Diego Garcia (British Indian Ocean Territory): Power Projection Hub
key_dimensions: Located in Chagos Archipelago — leased to USA as a key military base in the Indian Ocean
ICJ Advisory Opinion (2019) and UN Resolution declaring UK's administration illegal; Mauritius sovereignty claim
2024 UK-Mauritius deal to transfer sovereignty — implications for US base and India's neighborhood
India's position: strategic sensitivity given proximity to India's maritime interests and IOR security architecture

concepts.name: South China Sea Islands: Spratly and Paracel Islands Dispute
key_dimensions: Claimants: China, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Brunei, Taiwan — overlapping claims matrix
UNCLOS vs. China's 'Nine-Dash Line' (now Ten-Dash Line) — PCA ruling (2016) rejecting China's historical rights claim
Artificial island construction by China (Fiery Cross Reef, Mischief Reef) — militarization and FONOP responses by USA
India's stake: freedom of navigation for trade; ~55% of India's trade passes through South China Sea

concepts.name: Taiwan: Geopolitical Flashpoint and Semiconductor Significance
key_dimensions: Taiwan Strait as a critical chokepoint — 'First Island Chain' concept in US Indo-Pacific strategy
One China Policy vs. Taiwan Relations Act — India's official position and strategic ambiguity
TSMC dominance in semiconductor manufacturing — economic interdependence and supply chain vulnerability
UPSC trap: Taiwan is NOT a UN member state; distinguish between 'One China Policy' (India's stated position) and 'One China Principle'

concepts.name: Sri Lanka's Strategic Islands: Trincomalee and Colombo Port City
key_dimensions: Trincomalee — one of the world's finest natural harbors; historical British naval base; India-Sri Lanka cooperation on oil tank farms
Colombo Port City and Hambantota Port — Chinese investments and debt-trap diplomacy narrative
Katchatheevu Island: ceded by India to Sri Lanka in 1974; fishing rights controversy and constitutional validity debate
India's concern: Chinese submarine visits and potential dual-use infrastructure in India's near abroad

concepts.name: Maldives: Indian Ocean's Pivotal Small Island State
key_dimensions: Sits astride key SLOC between Gulf of Aden/Persian Gulf and Strait of Malacca — 'India's strategic backyard'
India-Maldives-China triangle: 'India Out' campaign, 2023 election of Muizzu and pivot toward China
Indian military/coast guard personnel presence: withdrawal demanded and partially executed in 2024
SAARC member; lowest-lying nation — climate change and sea-level rise making it a climate diplomacy actor

concepts.name: Seychelles and Assumption Island: India's Extended Maritime Reach
key_dimensions: Assumption Island agreement — India sought to develop infrastructure for maritime surveillance (agreement stalled due to domestic opposition)
Agalega Island (Mauritius): India developing airstrip and jetty — logistics hub for western Indian Ocean
Seychelles EEZ as one of the largest in the world — India's maritime patrol cooperation under SAGAR doctrine
UPSC trap: Distinguish Agalega (Mauritius) from Assumption (Seychelles) — both involve Indian infrastructure development

concepts.name: Andaman Sea Islands of Myanmar: Strategic Overhang on India
key_dimensions: Coco Islands (Myanmar) — alleged Chinese signal intelligence/monitoring station overlooking Andaman & Nicobar
China-Myanmar Economic Corridor (CMEC) and Kyaukpyu deep-sea port — Chinese access to Bay of Bengal bypassing Malacca
India's Kaladan Multimodal Project connecting Mizoram to Sittwe port — competing connectivity narratives
Post-2021 coup instability in Myanmar affecting India's Act East Policy and border security

concepts.name: Hawaiian Islands: US Strategic Pacific Anchor
key_dimensions: Pearl Harbor — HQ of US Indo-Pacific Command (USINDOPACOM); central to US rebalance to Asia strategy
Midpoint between US mainland and East Asia — logistics and force projection significance
UPSC context: Often appears in questions on QUAD, US alliance systems, or Pacific island geography
Distinguish: Hawaii (US state) vs. Guam (US unincorporated territory) vs. CNMI — different constitutional statuses

concepts.name: Guam and Mariana Islands: America's 'Unsinkable Aircraft Carrier'
key_dimensions: US unincorporated territory — hosts Andersen Air Force Base and Naval Base Guam (critical for Second Island Chain strategy)
Located in Micronesia, Western Pacific — strategic depth against North Korea and China
UPSC trap: Guam is NOT a US state; residents are US citizens but cannot vote in presidential elections
China's DF-26 (nicknamed 'Guam killer') ballistic missile — arms race dimension

concepts.name: Falkland Islands (Malvinas): Sovereignty Disputes and Resource Significance
key_dimensions: UK vs. Argentina sovereignty dispute — Falklands War (1982) and its impact on international law of self-determination
Location near Drake Passage — alternative to Panama Canal for Cape Horn routing
Hydrocarbon potential in surrounding waters — resource dimension of island disputes
UPSC angle: Model for comparing island sovereignty disputes (Falklands vs. South China Sea vs. Senkaku)

concepts.name: Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands: Japan-China Flashpoint
key_dimensions: Administered by Japan, claimed by China and Taiwan — East China Sea dispute
US-Japan Security Treaty Article 5 applies to Senkaku — American commitment to defend the islands
Rich fishing grounds and potential hydrocarbon reserves — economic drivers of the dispute
UPSC trap: Senkaku (Japanese name) = Diaoyu (Chinese name) = Diaoyutai (Taiwanese name) — same islands, different nomenclature

concepts.name: Island Chain Strategy: First, Second, and Third Island Chains
key_dimensions: First Island Chain: Japan, Ryukyu Islands, Taiwan, Philippines, Borneo — containment of Chinese naval expansion
Second Island Chain: Bonin Islands, Mariana Islands, Guam, Palau — US power projection perimeter
Third Island Chain: Hawaii to Aleutians — US homeland defense buffer
India's position: NOT part of island chain strategy but QUAD membership and IOR presence create complementary containment logic

concepts.name: Reunion Island and Mayotte: France's Indian Ocean Presence
key_dimensions: Reunion — French overseas department; Mayotte — French overseas collectivity; both in Indian Ocean
France's status as an Indo-Pacific power — French EEZ in Indian Ocean; basis for France-India strategic partnership
UPSC trap: Mayotte voted to remain French (2009 referendum) while Comoros claims it — active sovereignty dispute
France's role in IORA (Indian Ocean Rim Association) justified by these island territories

concepts.name: Strait-Adjacent Islands as Strategic Chokepoints: Global Comparison
key_dimensions: Hormuz: Qeshm Island (Iran) and Musandam Peninsula (Oman) — UPSC trap: Musandam is an exclave of Oman separated by UAE
Bab-el-Mandeb: Perim Island (Yemen) on the strait; Djibouti opposite — Horn of Africa dimension
Gibraltar: British Overseas Territory — Spain's claim; controls Atlantic-Mediterranean passage
UPSC pattern: Match the strait with the correct bordering islands/territories — frequent map-based questions

concepts.name: Arctic Islands: Svalbard, Greenland, and the New Geopolitical Frontier
key_dimensions: Svalbard Treaty (1920): Norwegian sovereignty but all signatory nations have equal rights to exploit resources — India is a signatory
Greenland: Danish autonomous territory — US interest in purchase (Trump); rare earth mineral significance
Northwest Passage opening due to Arctic ice melt — Canadian sovereignty claim vs. international strait argument
India's Arctic Policy (2022) and Himadri research station at Svalbard — India as a 'near-Arctic state'

concepts.name: Nicobar Islands vs. Andaman Islands: Internal Strategic Differentiation
key_dimensions: Great Nicobar Island development project: transshipment port, international airport, township — environmental controversy (Great Nicobar is a Biosphere Reserve)
Car Nicobar proximity to Strait of Malacca (~150 km) vs. Port Blair's Bay of Bengal orientation — different threat perceptions
Tribal reserves: Sentinelese (North Sentinel), Shompen (Great Nicobar) — conflict between development and tribal protection
UPSC trap: Indira Point on Great Nicobar is India's southernmost point, NOT the southernmost point of the Andaman Islands

concepts.name: Pacific Island Nations: QUAD's Strategic Periphery and China's Influence
key_dimensions: Solomon Islands security pact with China (2022) — alarm for Australia; proximity to critical shipping lanes
Kiribati, Nauru, Tuvalu: switching diplomatic recognition between China and Taiwan — 'checkbook diplomacy'
COFA (Compact of Free Association) states — Marshall Islands, Palau, Micronesia — strategic partnership with USA including military basing rights
India's engagement: Forum for India-Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC) — India's outreach to 14 Pacific Island nations
